source._python_note: CPython 3.12.16 compiled from source (python_runtime above), not Ubuntu's python3 3.12.3 package: since 2026-10-10 the Ubuntu Python path compiles the pinned python.org release against Ubuntu's libraries in BOTH the vendor stage (whose interpreter builds the wheels) and the offline build (whose interpreter ships), so the wheelhouse ABI (cp312) equals the runtime interpreter. builder == base == ubuntu:24.04; no python:*-slim (Debian) image anywhere in the build.
source._extra_pip_note: WHY THE PIN SET IS IN extra_pip AND NOT requirements_file/pip_constraints_url. Upstream's tested pin set is requirements/base.txt (uv pip compile of pyproject.toml + base.in) -- the file their own lean Docker image installs. It starts with `-e ./superset-core`, an editable local path: pip refuses it in a constraints file ('Unnamed requirements are not allowed as constraints', verified), so pip_constraints_url cannot point at it; and installing it with requirements_file would need extra_pip to name the app as `apache-superset`, which scripts/preflight.py's check_app_is_installed does not accept for slug `superset`. So pip_install_spec installs the application and extra_pip carries base.txt's 156 `name==ver` lines verbatim (same order), with: the editable superset-core replaced by apache-superset-core==0.1.0rc3 (the version the in-tree superset-core/pyproject.toml declares at the tag); psycopg2==2.9.13 added as the PostgreSQL driver (base.txt has none and the metadata DB is PostgreSQL), built from its source distribution against Ubuntu's libpq (libpq-dev at build, libpq5 at runtime) instead of psycopg2-binary, whose 2.9.9 wheel bundles its own OpenSSL 1.1 (libssl.so.1.1/libcrypto.so.1.1, end of life), Kerberos, LDAP and libpq copies that no Ubuntu update reaches and scanners do not see as packages; and 17 pins raised for CVEs (see dep_bumps), four of them outside the ranges the apache-superset 6.1.0 wheel declares, which wheel_requires_overrides widens. An unpinned `pip install apache-superset` was measured as the alternative and rejected: it resolves Flask 3.1 (upstream tests 2.3.3), flask-sqlalchemy 3.0, paramiko 5, flask-limiter 4 -- an untested stack. RETARGET: regenerate this list from the new tag's requirements/base.txt (grep -E '^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+==' requirements/base.txt) and re-apply only the bumps the new pins still need; drop wheel_requires_overrides entries the new release's own ranges already admit.

wheel_requires_overrides.why: apache-superset 6.1.0 declares cryptography<47, Pillow<13, pyarrow<19 and msgpack<1.1, and the CVE fixes are only outside them: cryptography GHSA-g6cj-pr64-35w5 (H, fixed 50.0.0), GHSA-jwv3-5hgf-82ww (H, 49.0.0), GHSA-537c-gmf6-5ccf (H, 48.0.1), GHSA-m2h6-j472-rp4c (M); Pillow GHSA-8g5g-8vmr-9782 (C) and GHSA-58r4-6rv3-gfh8, -pchr-8j38-3x4p, -c6hw-5grf-ff96, -65qm-jvmh-6pqg, -p4wg-p73j-c528, -q45j-58j2-45rg (H), all fixed only in 13.0.0; pyarrow GHSA-rgxp-2hwp-jwgg (H, 23.0.1); msgpack GHSA-6v7p-g79w-8964 (H, 1.2.1). Upstream master has moved all four past these ceilings (cryptography>=50.0.2,<51; Pillow>=13.0.0,<14; pyarrow>=26,<27; msgpack>=1.2.3,<1.3). Each new range is bounded to the major (minor for msgpack) that was tested. TESTED 2026-10-22 on the controller, CPython 3.12, against upstream's own pins as the control (same 159-package set, only these libraries and their pyOpenSSL/certifi/setuptools neighbours different): Superset's own unit suite (tests/common + tests/unit_tests at the 6.1.0 tag, 5,070 tests: the same outcome for every test on both sets, 4,968 passing; the 76 failures and 22 errors are identical on both and come from optional modules the image does not ship -- fastmcp, the BigQuery/Trino/Presto drivers, prophet -- or from tests that read the source checkout) and a booted instance on PostgreSQL 16 driven through the REST API -- login, a database with an encrypted password, SQL Lab (250 rows of int/decimal/text/date/timestamp/timestamptz/array/json/bool/null, CSV export), a dataset, chart data as json/csv/xlsx and with pivot/rolling post-processing, a saved chart, a dashboard and its export, CSV upload -- gave identical results on both sets; in-process, SupersetResultSet (pyarrow), the Arrow IPC + msgpack results payload round trip, screenshot tiling, thumbnail resize and PDF building (Pillow), Fernet/EncryptedType, paramiko keys, sshtunnel and pyOpenSSL also matched. The code paths Superset uses (PIL Image.open/new/resize with Resampling.LANCZOS; pa.array/Table/ipc/parquet/ArrowSerializationError; msgpack dumps/loads with use_bin_type) exist unchanged in the new versions.

source._build_packages_note: Ubuntu 24.04 names. The pipvendor stage is FROM the compiled-CPython stage, which already installed the CPython build toolchain (build-essential, pkg-config and the -dev libraries, gen_dockerfile.PY_SRC_BUILD_PKGS), so a compiler is present; libpq-dev adds pg_config and libpq's headers for psycopg2's source build. Everything else in the 159-package closure is a binary cp312 manylinux x86_64 wheel except three pure-Python sdists (odfpy, pgsanity, WTForms-JSON) that build with setuptools alone. None of this reaches the runtime image.
